title: Rank-one derived difference model for countable ind-unipotent norm-coefficient modules
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, an algebraic closure $\Omega/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with its extended norm topology, a finite intermediate field $E$, and $F=E$ or $F=\Omega$. Put $A(S)=C(S,F)$, using all continuous maps on the coherent profinite site [def-sfb-continuous-map-condensed-ring], in compatible universes containing all profinite parameter sets [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $G$ be any profinite group (a compact Hausdorff totally disconnected topological group), and put $H=\mathbf Z_\ell$ with its inverse-limit topology. Use ordinary internal $A$-modules [sk-def-sfb-module-objects] and condensed group actions [def-sfb-condensed-action-module].

Let $V_0\subseteq V_1\subseteq\cdots$ be a sequence of finite-dimensional norm-topological $E$-vector spaces with injective $E$-linear transition maps. For every $n$, let $D_n:V_n\to V_n$ be nilpotent, meaning $D_n^{e_n}=0$ for some integer $e_n\geq1$. Assume the $D_n$ commute with transition maps. Give each $V_n$ a continuous $E$-linear $G$-action, compatible with transition maps and commuting with $D_n$. Give $H$ the action
$$t\cdot v=\exp(tD_n)v=\sum_{j=0}^{e_n-1}\frac{t^jD_n^jv}{j!}.$$
This is a finite sum, with $t$ mapped through $\mathbf Z_\ell\subset E$. Let $M_n(S)=C(S,F\otimes_E V_n)$ with its finite-dimensional product norm topology, and use the induced $G\times H$-action. Form $M=\operatorname{colim}_{n\geq0} M_n$ in the category of internal $A$-modules with this action; this is a sheaf colimit, without completing its sections or imposing a uniform nilpotence bound. Let $D$ be the induced internal endomorphism and let $\tau=1\in H$. Thus $\tau-1=\exp(D)-1$ is an internal endomorphism of $M$, defined at every finite stage by the finite sum above.

Write $\Gamma_H^G:\mathcal A_{G\times H}(A)\to\mathcal A_G(A)$ for the $H$-fixed-submodule functor retaining the $G$-action, with the inflation adjunction of [lem-sfb-condensed-product-action-inflation]. In the ordinary derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], there is an isomorphism
$$R\Gamma_H^G(M[0])\ \cong\ Q\bigl([\,M\xrightarrow{\ \exp(D)-1\ }M\,]\bigr)\quad\text{in }D(\mathcal A_G(A)),$$
where the displayed complex is in degrees $0,1$ and $Q$ denotes localization of complexes. The isomorphism induces in degree zero the identification of $H$-fixed sections with $\ker(\exp(D)-1)$ given by their common inclusion in $M$. The derived functor is the ordinary right derived functor in the full action category, not a derived functor computed only within the displayed class of modules. The assertion includes $G=1$, zero stages, $D_n=0$, and unbounded dimensions and nilpotence orders. For $F=\Omega$ the noncomplete norm topology and all continuous maps are retained.
